findings: Clean native-native and native-browser passed; all three mute-recovery paths passed.

Clean browser-browser repeat stayed below the unchanged 2 GiB memory ceiling, but one audio cadence calibration failed. Earlier selected-binary browser memory recheck passed and remains separately recorded in streaming-hash-memory.json.
Native impairment lost most usable ingress media before assembly and one peer reported repeated QUIC send-buffer pressure; loss detection under deep packet reordering is being investigated.
Native-browser impairment timed out during WebRTC readiness; signaling proxy had an answer and no proxy errors. Exact ICE/DTLS cause is not established.
Browser-browser impairment reached the full 60-second window, passed decoded motion/audio/source identity, but failed both A/V calibrations.
No failed attempt is promoted by prospective observer or transport repairs. Fresh full profile measurements are required.

Prospective repairs do not promote these failures.
